notes: Shares are proposal targets, not a promise of accepted-pool distributions; the report records actual cases and exclusions.
Context is a contiguous suffix of the current utterance, never another speaker's utterance.
Student distillation uses 16 context tokens and 16 candidate tokens; the installed app is unchanged.
Readings are dictionary-derived and unreviewed; ambiguous longest dictionary matches are skipped.
No target injection, automatic reference labels, pure English targets or training on eval/ files.
